scripts.dev: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/web run dev --
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/extension run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/shared run test && npm --workspace apps/web run test
scripts.test:functions: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace functions run build
